subject: BluePeak integration: marketplace listing & co-sell entitlement coordination
messages:
From: Sarah Tong <sarah.tong@bluepeak.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: BluePeak + Redwood: marketplace listing & co-sell interest

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the dedicated routing and cost controls you showed are exactly what our customers ask for. BluePeak Systems is ready to pursue a formal listing on AWS Marketplace and an initial co-sell engagement with Redwood.

High-level asks from our side:
- Fast-track listing support for an AMI and SaaS contract SKU (we plan to publish on AWS and later on Azure/GCP).
- Co-sell entitlement and lead routing with Redwood sales (shared leads for joint reps).
- Guidance on metering/pricing model (bring-your-own-license vs. subscription).

We can gather technical artifacts and security evidence — attaching our marketplace sales deck and a first-pass pricing sheet. Could you point us to Redwood’s marketplace intake checklist and a suggested mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align timelines? Also looping in Lauren on the commercial side.

Attachments: [BluePeak_AWS_SalesDeck.pdf (PDF, 3.4MB)] [pricing_proposal.xlsx (XLSX, 40KB)]

Best,
Sarah Tong
Head of Partnerships, BluePeak Systems
[sarah.tong@bluepeak.com]
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Tong <sarah.tong@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Oct 2028 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BluePeak + Redwood: marketplace listing & co-sell interest

Hi Sarah — great to hear and congrats on moving this forward. We’d love to run the joint intake. Initial suggestions:

1) Intake checklist (we’ll send a fillable checklist, but high level):
   - Legal/commercial template preference (SaaS contract vs. AWS Marketplace contract)
   - SKU definition and pricing cadence
   - Technical artifact pack (deployment guide, AMI/container image, healthcheck endpoints)
   - Security evidence (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, DPA)

2) MAP / timeline suggestion:
   - Week 0: Intake form + evidence upload
   - Week 1–2: Technical review & entitlements mapping
   - Week 3: Marketplace packaging & test listing
   - Week 4–6: Go-live + co-sell enablement pack

Neha (cc) will own technical onboarding and will share the intake doc. Lauren — could you advise on the co-sell terms you want to propose (rev share vs. referral, lead routing expectations)?

I’ll also open a joint HubSpot deal and request a short kickoff call early next week.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Tong <sarah.tong@bluepeak.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Oct 2028 11:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: BluePeak + Redwood: marketplace listing & co-sell interest

Thanks Nikhil — attaching a slightly cleaned pricing_proposal.xlsx and a zip with our security pack. A few notes:
- We prefer subscription SKUs for the initial launch (predictable revenue for partners).
- For co-sell, we'd like 70/30 (Redwood/BluePeak) on net ARR for jointly sourced deals; open to discussion.
- We'll need a sandbox account for testing AMI deployment and a short push to your engineering contact for marketplace packaging.

Attachments: [pricing_proposal_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)] [co-sell-evidence.zip (ZIP, 2.1MB): contains SOC2-summary.pdf, DPA.pdf, network-diagram.png]

On Thu, Oct 4, 2028 at 11:14 AM Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick note — thanks for the artifacts. Neha will triage the security pack and confirm gaps.
>
> — Nikhil

Best,
Sarah
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sarah Tong <sarah.tong@bluepeak.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Oct 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: BluePeak + Redwood: marketplace listing & co-sell interest

Folks — quick technical sync notes after looking at the zip:

- SOC2 summary is fine for an initial gating review; need the actual control matrix for final listing (Neha: can you request this from them?).
- AMI packaging: BluePeak has both AMI and container; marketplace packaging differs by SKU type. We should aim for an AMI-first listing for AWS and plan containerized release for Azure/GCP.
- Metering: subscription SKU on AWS Marketplace still requires us to map over entitlement metadata (instances/licenses). I’ll draft the entitlement mapping template.

Immediate asks:
1) BluePeak to confirm which AMI region(s) to publish (us-east-1 primary; others optional).
2) BluePeak to provide a test AMI snapshot or container image link to our staging account.
3) A short SSO/Entitlement integration doc (how you plan to exchange order/entitlement webhooks).

I propose a 30-minute engineering kickoff on Thursday — Neha, can you own the invite? Sarah, confirm availability.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Partner Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: entitlement_template.xlsx (will be uploaded to Drive)]
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Tong <sarah.tong@bluepeak.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BluePeak + Redwood: marketplace listing & co-sell interest

Team — quick sprint plan and owners to keep momentum:

- Intake & evidence (Due: Mon 10/15): BluePeak to upload control matrix + final AMI region list (owner: Sarah).
- Technical kickoff (Thu 10/18): Ben & Neha to run; BluePeak to provide staging AMI link by 10/16.
- Commercial sync (Mon 10/22): Lauren + Sarah to finalize rev-share and lead routing.
- Marketplace packaging (10/23–10/30): Ben -> packaging + test listing in staging; Redwood to request early access from aws-marketplace-ops.

Lauren — please confirm if 70/30 is acceptable for initial pilot or if you want to propose a counter. I’ll create the HubSpot deal (ID HS-987654) and add the MAP tasks.

Next steps for Sarah: upload the final artifacts to the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bbluepeak-evidence) and confirm test AMI region(s).

Thanks all — this feels actionable.

—Nikhil
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
[Sent from Redwood mailbox]
